message.content: A magazine cover with the masthead "TEMPO" in large blue capital letters dominates the top. Below it, the tagline reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above the masthead, smaller text says "BERKELIT DARI PAJAK SAWIT" and "WAWANCARA KETUA UMUM PSSI". The main image depicts a large, golden, flame-shaped structure atop a light-gray tiered pedestal against a cloudy blue sky. On the left side of the pedestal's top tier, a small human figure in a dark uniform and orange helmet holds a long rod attached to a blue lower-case "f" symbol. To the right, another similar figure holds a long, flexible line with a blue bird symbol at the end, which is curved high in the air. A third dark figure is partially visible below the top tier. To the left of the central structure, large white text reads "PERANG DIGITAL PILKADA JAKARTA" with smaller text below: "TIGA KANDIDAT GUBERNUR DKI BEREBUT SUARA LEWAT MEDIA SOSIAL. MENYERANG DENGAN AKUN TAK RESMI." The bottom left includes date "28 NOVEMBER - 4 DESEMBER 2016", price "RP 45.000", and a barcode.
